title: Setup: build Spring Boot #52321 (S32) at both pins and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md, case S32 (spring-projects/spring-boot#52321: Missing intermediate health contributors resolve as absent). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/S32-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-boot-pr-links-s01-s50), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of module:spring-boot-health with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names on JDK 25, runs the landed test classes (HealthEndpointSupportTests (test) ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of module:spring-boot-health in $P/artifacts/S32-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned S32

resources.notes: the reruns of 2026-11-27 took 5-7 minutes with a peak of 3.8-4.6 GiB

steps.name: S32 fix: build and landed tests
S32 parent: build and the parent's tests
